description: This is a Python source file that implements the backend API for telemetry ingestion, predictive modeling, and alert management in a real-time vehicle monitoring system using FastAPI framework. It defines several endpoints for health checks, telemetry data ingestion, prediction, model metadata retrieval, alert listing, and alert acknowledgment, with detailed request handling, logging, and exception management.
